desc: Redraw this raccoon as a detailed 16-bit indie game sprite: realistic raccoon proportions, same face, gray fur, black eye mask, ringed tail, green scarf, small pouch, small plain eyes, same pose and silhouette. Muted natural palette, thin dark navy outline, 3-4 shade steps with pixel clusters, deeper shadows under head and belly, highlights on ears and tail rings, subtle fur shading. No gradients, no ground shadow.
